title: NI-G0: fail closed on dated Situation Room detail fetch failure
objective: In the existing dated static Situation Room adapter only, prevent NO_NEW_MATERIAL_CATALYST/PASS when a relevant same-day deterministic briefing was identified but its second (detail) retrieval failed, despite a PASS landing receipt. Preserve real primary events and their original authority and generic owner's intentional independent primary-only semantics. Do not change source membership, workflow cadence or global coverage policy. Scope is original #1888/#1563; distinct from prior cancelled-run repair and schedule-stale signature.

evidence.summary: Direct main commit read at audit; source paths below are pinned to this commit.

direct_daily_candidate_links returns the same dated URL; apply_situation_room_retrieval_fail_closed only checks landing receipt and apply_dated_discovery_fail_closed only checks DISCOVERY_UNVERIFIED, not DISCOVERY_FETCH_FAILED.

run fetches landing, then fetches candidate independently; failed discovery candidate enters unverified_discoveries and does not enter current_discoveries. With 6/6 primary landings PASS, no events and no unresolved primary candidates, daily_result is NO_NEW_MATERIAL_CATALYST.

Existing generic owner's test_discovery_fetch_failure_does_not_veto_clean_primary_no_event intentionally preserves primary-only semantics. Do not change this generic contract; add the narrow static adapter regression.
Existing static tests cover failure of initial landing and missing publication time, not failed second retrieval after successful initial response.
Original NI-G0/G2 mission. This is code-derived failure path, not a claimed observed live incident.

Existing code path instead returns NO_NEW_MATERIAL_CATALYST/PASS. Static inspection established branch path; actual Python regression execution pending. Do not self-declare CODEX_READY. Compare with distinct schedule-stale remediation dd02bd749c3ef9b2172d and prior August cancellation repair (POST_FIX_OBSERVATION); avoid touching their workflow scope.

positive: Successful landing + detail and legitimate independent primary no-event preserves current semantics when no unresolved dated discovery exists.
